name: persistent-memory-worker
description: persistent-memory BullMQ ingest worker (Phase 6) — consumes the pm.ingest queue and runs the 7-step pipeline (fetch → extract → chunk → persist → embed (Mode A) → graphiti → status), EMBEDDING_MODE-aware, writing team-stamped rows via @pm/db's runInTenant under RLS. Consumes @pm/db + @pm/shared (storage/queue/extract/embeddings/qdrant).

scripts.test: npm run build -w @pm/graph && npm run build -w @pm/evidence-files && npm run build -w @pm/security-dlp && vitest run
